summary: Firecrawl's headline performance claims (README.md:54-55: 96% web coverage, P95 3.4s) have no method or data in the repo; the 96% links to the vendor's own blog. The only committed measurements are 8 historical artillery load-test write-ups (apps/test-suite/load-test-results, with one raw report JSON), with no runnable load-test config in the tree, plus an index-cache benchmark notebook with no saved outputs. Quality evals are dispatched to a separate 'scrape-evals' repo, so nothing about extraction accuracy is reproducible from this clone. Marketing numbers in apps/test-site blog posts (e.g. '10x faster') are crawler test-fixture content and were excluded.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
